QUOTE: The schema and code axes are never auto-refreshed, because a build from a stale server process would re-stamp the index with old pipeline logic and could drop layers. The auto-refresh path never attempts that build.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes auto-refresh skipping the schema/code axes, but never states that the write path refuses (rather than warns) ahead of the build decision so that force can't override it.
